Add integrable-integrand Monte Carlo variants (unbiasedness and consistency without assuming the integrand measurable), the a.e.-equality lemma for Monte Carlo estimates, and importance-sampling theorems for integrands only integrable under the target (density and Radon-Nikodym forms), with importing tests; Atlas extension of the synced Monte Carlo API.
